pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Refs #868. This is a **draft performance candidate**, not a claim that higher batch coverage is a speedup. It remains open for correctness and locked-9700X qualification before #868 can be closed.

Original base: `1a9955ab5c3cb85d6ef6e346f1ab422abc995384`. The published candidate normally integrates pinned main `ce1bea1eeb8ece6db744726875b136fba023d317`, including #918's shared-emission repair, through additive commits; all four original #883 implementation/test files remain byte-identical to `0797050b189bde8a0c7a36beb568a80430d62dec`.

## Implementation

- Preserve the existing adjacent two/three-node fast path; attempt the new out-of-line path only for supported roots with a non-VALUE child.
- Prove a closed, contiguous executable postorder fragment of at most 16 nodes with a bounded explicit reverse stack. Repeated/reordered operands, holes from skipped subtrees, unsupported operations and effects fall back without emitting entries.
- Initially admit ordinary signed/unsigned 32/64-bit integer operations and transparent wrappers with empty conversions. Shifts, pointer arithmetic, loads, floating/narrow arithmetic, atomics, aggregates and `_BitInt` retain their existing lowering.
- Classify the proved fragment, stage reached-leaf payloads, preflight entry and conservative scalar-task capacity, then compact occupied slots into kinds/classes/payload columns. Preserve the scalar final diagnostic token and evaluated-node accounting.
- Replace the classifier's >4-row wide type gathers with bounded scalar metadata loads while retaining the SIMD operator lookup. The established <=4-row path is unchanged.
- An opt-in `BUSTER_CHECK_LOWER_FRAGMENT_TRACE` build prints attempted nested-root outcomes: order, bound, operator, effect, type, conversion, payload or capacity refusal. These are attempted-root diagnostics, **not** an all-expression rejection histogram; never use a trace build for timing.

## Regression tests added

Registered in the existing checker batch suite, not an uncalled standalone fixture. Compare the real scalar drain, normal dispatch and direct candidate, including untouched output, status, token, depth and evaluated-node counts. Check successful streams against independent entry literals too.

Coverage includes unary chains, left/right binary nesting, balanced trees, transparent-wrapper holes, signed/unsigned 32/64-bit classes, the 16/17-node boundary, real conversions, repeated/reordered operands, effects, folded-subtree gaps, shifts, limited capacities and output ending exactly at protected pages. Input graph/value/conversion columns also end at protected pages.

## Validation / acceptance gates

- [x] Independent material review of actual published head `cecd49628570e28004254a5639f10d74a13d3346`, tree `4558f8ae3a7260670a186df0871088b250df1a3f`: clean normal merge of `b68c62de` and accepted main `ce1bea1e`. The four original implementation/test files remain byte-identical to `0797050b`; every other entry matches the pinned parent.
- [x] Fresh Clang 23.1.4 `-O3` ordinary full checker runs on this exact commit: native **538,217 checks, zero failures**; baseline x86-64 **540,321 checks, zero failures**.
- [x] Required exact-head hosted/native CI: [run 41057707200](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/actions/runs/41057707200) passed both hosted O3 jobs, 9700X native correctness/benchmarks and final aggregation. Measurement storage passed separately; the PR libFuzzer skip is intentional.
- [x] Fresh complete default checker under O3 combined ASan/UBSan/bounds: native **538,217/0**, baseline **540,321/0**. Both builds instrument all 41 units, each passes eight fresh fatal symbolized detector controls, and both unconditional child-report audits are empty.
- [x] Propagate #918's completion/lifetime repair and verify the new composition: native O3 TSan full `test-check-units --keep` passes **552/0**, with 314 shared helper parts, a fresh fatal symbolized race control, all 41 units instrumented and an empty audit.
- [x] Fresh frozen-SQLite attempted-root inventory and matched-source object comparison for exact `cecd/4558`, accepted in [buster-performance #138](https://github.com/buster14a/buster-performance/pull/138): 11,290 attempted calls, 275 accepted calls, 1,473 accepted visits and 1,472 typed entries. These are bounded attempted-root counts, not global coverage. Any later measured-source change remains separately scoped; earlier records are not transferred.
- [ ] Effective hot-checker placement controls for normal layout plus offsets `0 16 64 256 1024 2048`, with actual hot-function/loop geometry and semantic-object checks. Preflight showed that the existing ordinary-text padding command leaves hot lowering addresses fixed; the reviewed #502 inside-section method is being adapted before timing.
- [ ] Locked 9700X repeated baseline A/A/candidate comparisons on SQLite and another real input, across the qualified placements and fresh copies, with object identity, node counts, lower-stage and whole-process timing.
- [x] Publish exact-commit ordinary/combined-sanitizer/TSan receipts: [buster-performance #137](https://github.com/buster14a/buster-performance/pull/137).
- [ ] Publish the completed timing campaign's raw logs, harnesses and exact source/input/binary identities.
- [ ] Authentic original-material certification for the two unsigned original contributions; prospective merge sign-offs do not close that gate.

The five new executions ran on the Ryzen 9 7940HS under separate core grants. The actual commit existed before all five fresh archives and runs; independent review matched all **807 source blobs and modes**, 41-unit build records, binary identities, runtime controls, statuses and source/binary checks. No test filter, suppression or successful retry replaces a failed run. The ordinary metadata's original derived label is explicitly corrected in the evidence: ordinary sanitizer units are **0**, address/thread units **41**, with raw receipts preserved.

These results qualify the recorded full checker commands and focused shared-emission test on exact `cecd/4558`. They do not execute later main `bfcfc35f`, establish the whole correctness-list/fuzzer matrix, transfer older inventory counts, or demonstrate performance. The native MSan timeout in old main `674ae159` remains a separately recorded, unexplained failure: one bounded local diagnostic did not reproduce it ([records #143](https://github.com/buster14a/buster-performance/pull/143)). It is not relabeled as this commit's execution.

Historical evidence [#133](https://github.com/buster14a/buster-performance/pull/133) (`9b33/5648`) and [#134](https://github.com/buster14a/buster-performance/pull/134) (`b68/88dc`) retains every raw record and exact revision scope. The prior #624 record observed slower speculative/cached approaches under its recorded conditions; [scope addendum #135](https://github.com/buster14a/buster-performance/pull/135) distinguishes ordinary-text padding from demonstrated hot-drain placement without changing historical samples. No speedup or multi-input/multi-layout acceptance is claimed; this PR remains draft.

## Provenance / DCO

The original implementation and tests remain unchanged, with their Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception notices and original commits preserved. All three additive integration commits carry the maintainer's prospective sign-off through the repository hook under the actual session opt-in. That does not retroactively certify the two original unsigned PR commits; their original-material certification gate remains open. The half-fixture correction is the exact already-reviewed project change from `d8738fb0`, preserving every special input and comparison. No third-party implementation was imported.

Validation update for head `0797050b189bde8a0c7a36beb568a80430d62dec`:

- Fixed the first CI compile failure: the new literal-test `integer_class` variable was used only in the AVX-512 assertions but declared for scalar hosts too. It now lives inside the vector-only assertion block. Both initial hosted jobs selected scalar kernels, so they exposed the same `-Werror,-Wunused-variable` failure.
- Ran a focused native sanitizer harness for the **exact SIMD output-compaction sequence extracted from `c_check_program_fragment.c`**: all **65,536** 16-bit occupancy masks passed against independent scalar compaction. Kinds, classes and full-width payloads agreed; all three output tails ended at protected pages and pre-existing prefixes stayed unchanged. Built with Clang 17, `-O2 -march=native -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all`. This tests output compaction in isolation, **not** the real checker's complete fragment admission/drain integration, and is not a performance result.
- The replacement CI run is https://github.com/buster14a/buster/actions/runs/40926017203. Measurement-storage policy has passed; the two hosted compiler builds were still in progress at the latest check. Full checker/oracle and gated 9700X vector results are not yet established.

The draft/performance acceptance gates in the description remain unchanged. In particular, no frozen-SQLite rejection inventory or locked multi-corpus/multi-layout speedup has been established, so this PR must not yet be treated as closing #868.
